page_title: RSO 1-1 ATM | Real Sociedad v Atletico Madrid 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+4' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) shows confidence. He receives the ball and fires in a first-time strike. The surprised goalkeeper is quite fortunate, because the effort goes just wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Takefusa Kubo is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
88' Substitution. Brais Mendez walks off the pitch and Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
87' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

86' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid). The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.

86' What a wasted opportunity by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Jan Oblak makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
83' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
83' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Alex Remiro.
78' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
77' Handball by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).
75' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) receives a yellow card for infringement.
75' The attendance is 31576.
74' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) drills a first-timer from the edge of the box that flew towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper stops the shot from going into his goal with a quick save.
72' Substitution. Benat Turrientes did his best and is replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
72' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Goncalo Guedes will be replaced by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Koke departs the field of play to be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid).
70' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
69' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
67' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
66' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
63' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
63' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
60' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Julian Alvarez is replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
60' We are about to witness a subsitution. Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) for Alex Baena.
59' Flag goes up against Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Takefusa Kubo tees up Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top left corner and past Jan Oblak.
54' The players claim that Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
52' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.

50' 0 - 1 Giuliano Simeone showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 0:1.
48' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
48' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
47' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak makes a comfortable save.
46' Half-time substitution. Matteo Ruggeri will not participate anymore and Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is coming on.
46' Diego Simeone makes a switch. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is coming on in place of Pablo Barrios at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Juan Martinez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The goal by Real Sociedad won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45+1' The goal for Real Sociedad is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
45' OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is unlucky enough to head the ball into his own net. 1:0.
44' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.

40' It's unbelievable, Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Jan Oblak reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
40' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

39' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
39' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
38' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) decided to try his luck with a first-time shot. He probably immediately regrets his decision as he skies the ball out.
36' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
36' Atl. Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

30' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the left post.
30' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
28' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
28' The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
26' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down. Juan Martinez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
16' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Jan Oblak.
14' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
13' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Martinez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
12' Golden chance! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
7' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
7' Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.
7' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
5' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
3' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.

Atl. Madrid will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
